*Dr. Yang Chen is an Associate Professor in the Department of History, College of Liberal Arts of Shanghai University, and Executive Director of the Centre for Turkish Studies at Shanghai University. He has published two books about Turkey and several papers in journals such as Critical Sociology, Sociology of Islam, Belt & Road Initiative Quarterly, and Arab World Research, among others. His focus is on political Islamic movements in Turkey, party politics in Turkey, Turkey’s foreign policy, and China-Turkey relations.
